to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

DIMENSIONS FOR TYRE VALVE THREADS 

PART 3 THREADS, 10V1 f 1SV1, 17V1 AND 20V1 



1. Scope — Covers the limiting dimensions and tolerances for tyre valve threads 10V1. 15V1, 17V1 
and20V1. 

2. Designation — Valve threads shall be designated as follows: 

Nomina/ Dimensions Designation 

mm 

9-6 x 1'00 10V1 

15 xl'OO • 15V1 

17 x 1'00 17V1 

20*5 X 1-00 20V1 

3. Dimensions and Tolerances — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Thread Gauging — Shall be according to IS : 2334-1975 'Gauging practice for ISO metric 
screw threads ( first revision ) \ 

4.1 Values given in Table 1 have been calculated so that it is possible to apply to the threads 
thus define the limit gauge inspection principles specified in IS : 2334-1975. 

4.2 For the fabrication of the gauges, the following tolerances extracted from IS : 2334-1975 have 
been chosen: 

Pitch diameter of external thread ( d% ) 24 /*m < T& < 50 /*m 
Outside diameter of external thread ( d ) 36 fim < T& < 85 /am 
Pitch diameter of internal thread ( D 8 ) 24 /Am < T D2 < 50 j*m 
Inside diameter of internal thread ( Di ) 38 ^m < T D < 100 /*m 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Tyre valve threads are special threads for valves used in tyre tubes. These threads are 
different from those covered by IS : 4218 ' ISO metric screw threads \ This Indian Standard 
( Part 3 ) is one of a series of standards on tyre valve threads. Other standards In this series are 
IS : 9449 ( Part 1 )-1980 covering 5V1, 5V2, 6V1 and 8V1 threads and IS : 9449 ( Part 2 ) covering 
9V1,10V2and12V1 threads. 

This and other parts of this standard are In conformity with corresponding parts of ISO 4570 
' Tyre valve threads ', Issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). However, 
tyres valves threads 8V2, 11V1, 13V1, 13V2 f 16V1, 17V2, 17V3 and 19V1 have not been covered by 
the Indian standards as these sizes of threads are now obsolete.
